Name: 6480's Slightly Better Item Sprites
Description:
Not much to say about this one, just look at the image.

You can edit the config.json file or use Generic Mod Config menu to turn off the edits for some items, if you prefer the vanilla look.

I may or may not add more sprites to this mod; this is really only my personal edits, so it depends on how I feel. (If you're wondering about the cranberries, all it does is move them up a couple pixels haha)

Manifest.Name: (CP) 6480's Slightly Better Item Sprites
Manifest.Description: A vanilla-style retexture for some items that makes them look a bit nicer.
